component.name: Dropin
component.summary: Install Linux apps from packages or URLs without the terminal

description.p: Dropin installs desktop applications on Linux by drag-and-drop or from a download / GitHub release URL. It detects AppImage, DEB, RPM, Flatpak, and portable archives, checks integrity, and guides a safe install.
Track apps installed through Dropin to launch them, check for upstream updates, and uninstall cleanly. The interface follows your system light or dark theme.
Integrity checks, system theme matching, and Settings layout fixes.

ul.li: HTTPS, SHA-256, and package content verification on downloads
Clearer update checks with audit log entries
UI surfaces follow the desktop Window palette

description.p: Initial release: drag-and-drop and URL installs for AppImage, DEB, RPM, Flatpak, and archives.
